html.<b>この絵で言えるのは②までです。</b>③から先は油の話で、電気の通り道の外: This diagram can take you as far as ②. From ③ on it is about oil, outside the electrical path. The diagram doesn't know how much oil pressure there is, and doesn't pretend to.
html.<b>まずエンジンを止めてください。原因を探すのはそれからです。</b> この警:
Stop the engine first. Look for the cause after that. This warning light is the signal that "oil is not being pushed through the engine". If you keep running it with genuinely no oil pressure, the crankshaft bearings are damaged in a short time (the kind of damage that means taking the engine out). Stop somewhere safe, switch off, and first look at the dipstick. If the oil is low, top it up.
But — this lamp lights in exactly the same way for an electrical fault. If the oil is at the right level and the lamp stays on, split the problem with the diagrams below.
html.<b>エンジンが回る</b>とオイルポンプが油圧を作り、その圧が<b>接点を押し: When the engine runs the oil pump builds pressure, and that pressure pushes the contact open.
html.<b>エンジン回転中＝消える。</b>センダの接点が開いて、輪が切れました。黄色: Engine running = out. The sender's contact has opened and the loop is broken. No yellow dots anywhere is the sign that "nothing is flowing".
html.<b>キーON・停止中＝点く。</b>黄色い点が一周しています。この輪がつながっ: Key ON, engine stopped = lit. The yellow dots go all the way round. As long as this loop is closed, the lamp is lit.
html.<b>圧の大きさも分かりません。</b>点くか点かないかの2つだけ。「ぎりぎり足: It doesn't know how high the pressure is either. Only two states: lit or not. "Barely enough" and "plenty to spare" are the same "out".
html.<b>本当に油圧が低い</b>（オイル不足・オイルポンプ・軸受の摩耗）。＝センダ: The oil pressure really is low (low oil, oil pump, worn bearings). = The sender is doing its job and the contact staying closed is correct. Suspect this first.
html.<b>止まっている間は圧ゼロ</b>。エンジンにねじ込まれたセンダの接点は<b>: While stopped, the pressure is zero. The contact of the sender screwed into the engine is closed, taking the lower side of the lamp to body ground.
html.<b>油の汚れも油温も見ていません。</b>別のスイッチも別の線もありません。: It doesn't watch how dirty or hot the oil is. There is no other switch and no other wire.
html.<b>油の量は見ていません。</b>減っていても圧が出ていれば消えたままです（逆: It doesn't watch the oil level. Even if the oil is low, the lamp stays out as long as there is pressure (and the other way round: with the right amount but no pressure, it lights).
html.<b>油圧センダの故障</b>（圧が掛かっても接点が開かなくなった）。: A faulty oil pressure sender (the contact no longer opens even under pressure).
html.<b>灰色の線の地絡</b>で確定（電気の故障・油圧は無関係）。線をメーターまで: Confirmed: the grey wire is shorting to ground (an electrical fault; oil pressure has nothing to do with it). Follow the wire by eye up to the speedometer and look for damaged or pinched insulation
html.<b>灰色の線（GRIGIO）が車体に触れている</b>（被覆が擦れての地絡）。: The grey wire (GRIGIO) is touching the body (insulation chafed through, shorting to ground).
html.<span class=\"qa-h\">よくある疑問</span> エンジン回: A common question With the engine running, put a tester on the grey wire (GRIGIO) and it shows 12 V. That isn't a fault; it is normal — 12 V arrives from the upper side of the lamp, and the lower side is a dead end, so the voltage gets there but no current flows. That is why, in the diagram above, the grey wire stays coloured while the warning light is out; the absence of yellow dots is what says "nothing is flowing". This is what lies behind "the tester reads, but it's still not fixed".
html.① 油圧センダの端子から<b>灰色の線を外す</b>: ① Disconnect the grey wire from the oil pressure sender terminal
html.② 外した線の先を<b>車体の金属に当てる</b>: ② Touch the end of the disconnected wire to bare body metal
html.⭐<b>そして、純正の取扱説明書がはっきり書いていることがもう1つあります</b: ⭐And there is one more thing the factory owner's handbook states clearly — when the engine is fully warm, at low revs such as idling, this warning light may come on even though nothing is wrong. Warm oil is thinner, and at low revs the pump delivers less, so the pressure drops to just about the lower limit. If it goes out when you raise the revs, that is normal. ⚠️ If it stays on while you are driving, that is another matter — stop right away.
html.このストーリーは <b>FIAT 500（D・F・L・R型）</b> の話です。: This story is about the FIAT 500 (D, F, L and R models). The wiring is drawn from the original 500 sources.
html.その「下限」は、純正の整備解説書では<b>0.5〜1.5 kg/cm²</b>と: The factory service manual gives that "lower limit" as 0.5–1.5 kg/cm² (the contact switches somewhere in this range). Not an oil pressure gauge, but a switch that reports the lower limit once — that is what the points above come down to.
html.ついでの疑問：「エンジンはゴムマウントで車体から浮いているのに、センダのアースは: A side question: "The engine sits on rubber mounts, isolated from the body — is the sender's ground all right?" — The sender's ground runs engine block → engine ground strap → body. The original wiring diagram draws no wire here either, just a ground symbol (meaning the threaded body is itself the ground). The current through the warning light is tiny, so a slightly weak ground here won't change how it lights — it shows up first as "the starter won't turn".
html.どれも「ランプの下側がアースに落ちている」という<b>まったく同じ状態</b>に: Each of these leads to exactly the same state: "the lower side of the lamp is grounded". Whichever of the three it is, you get this same single diagram — which is exactly why the next step disconnects one wire to split them.

html.エンジンは止めたまま、キーだけONにして行います（<b>エンジンを掛ける必要はあ: Do this with the engine stopped and only the key ON (there's no need to start the engine). If the grey wire is touching the body, the symptom shows even with the engine stopped.

html.ヒューズを疑いたくなりますが、<b>このランプの道はヒューズを通っていません</: It's tempting to suspect a fuse, but this lamp's path doesn't go through a fuse (terminal 30 of the ignition switch branches off the supply side of fuse F1). For the same reason as with the charge lamp, checking fuses won't fix this symptom.
html.ランプの下側が行き止まりになる＝流れない＝消える。つまり「消えた」は<b>油圧が: The lower side of the lamp becomes a dead end = no current = out. In other words, "it went out" is the signal that there is oil pressure.
html.切り分けは<b>線を1本外すだけ</b>で始められます。その前に、<b>なぜこの: You can start splitting the problem by disconnecting just one wire. Before that, one minute on why this lamp lights at all — once you see the logic, you can see where the electrics end and the oil begins.

html.油圧警告灯も、電気の通り道の途中に置かれた小さな電球です。輪が閉じれば点き、切れ: The oil pressure warning light is also a small bulb placed along an electrical path. Close the loop and it lights; break it and it goes out — and what opens and closes that loop is the oil pressure sender.
html.消えただけではなく、<b>なぜ消えるのかをもう知っています</b>——油圧が接点: It didn't just go out — you now know why it goes out: oil pressure pushed the contact open and the lower side of the lamp became a dead end. The grey wire stays coloured (12 V still reaches it) and only the yellow dots have gone. That is what "normal" looks like for this circuit.
